articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Strategy Leans On Equity Conversion To Sustain Aggressive Bitcoin Exposure. Strategy Inc, NasdaqGS:MSTR, has highlighted its focus on resilience to sharp Bitcoin price declines. The company is pursuing a plan to convert about $6b of bond debt into equity as part of its ongoing Bitcoin accumulation approach. Management has reiterated its intention to keep adding Bitcoin despite substantial unrealized losses on existing holdings.
